build: npm run build -- production, both detached checkouts; original stamped JS restored and checked against full SHA256 manifest before accepted production profiles
conditions: jit off; machine precision; 5 fresh-engine trials/process, 100 warmups, 400 calls/batch; three accepted alternating processes/tree/representation. Assignment and boxing are separately timed. Validators run outside timers. CPU profiles >=1500ms and >=1000 samples; allocations at 32768-byte interval over 1000 calls, including collected objects. Counts exclude validation.
interpretation: Fresh engine is not cold process startup. Profiles are instrumented and separate from timings. Source-via-tsx profiles contain generated name helpers; shipped performance conclusions use plain Node and minified bundles. Cache helper self time is not a bound on all cache overhead. Relevant inputs are unique after warmup.
exclusions: Functional checks and any attempt with CPU monitoring hits excluded. Initial mapped-chunk and long profile attempts excluded; accepted profiles use original measured production JS. No values inferred from failed/contended timing.
counterEncoding: Zero-valued cache counters are omitted; missing counter fields mean zero. All cache names are retained.
